findings.title: `website_name` bypasses the anonymous TL0 website privacy restriction
findings.body: `website` is an `untrusted_attribute`, so `include_website?` suppresses it when `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)` is true (for example, an anonymous viewer of a TL0 user). The new `website_name` attribute has no equivalent restriction and computes its value directly from `object.user_profile.website`, exposing at least the external hostname and, for same-domain URLs, the complete profile path even though the website field is intentionally hidden. Additionally, the inclusion predicate is named `include_website_name` rather than the serializer convention `include_website_name?`, so it will not be used as the attribute predicate. Define `include_website_name?` and apply the same visibility condition as `include_website?`; add an anonymous TL0 serialization test asserting that `website_name` is absent.
